intro: Kaela's Update is an Alliance dispatch in the Stonetalon Mountains, carrying captured correspondence between frontline operatives. The gnome mage Gaxim Rustfizzle sends the adventurer back to Kaela Shadowspear with intercepted Venture Company letters. The intelligence helps the night elf Sentinels track the goblin cartel's destructive expansion across sacred lands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, take these letters to Kaela. I'm sure she'll want to know about this. Or at least the Sentinels will.
Make sure you tell her how successful we were and how we couldn't have done it without a little bit of magic.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Yes, friend? What can I do for you?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You and Gaxim have done very well, friend. Thank you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
